repair_probe.note: At iteration 100 all three small global components are fragments of one ASP residue. No component contains anchored S, but its isolated N is only 3.49 A from the one CYS S outside its dead zone. Together with exact/dead-zone/disabled controls, this suggests coupled local packing; it does not justify excluding spring involvement merely because the disconnected residue is unanchored.

notes: All default geometry trajectories use numerical implementation 2c4e846. Later commits add reporting fields, failed-validation diagnostics and correct explicit-reference source eligibility; no matrix case uses that explicit-reference setting. The later rollback-only rounding guard is also unused by this per-atom matrix, so its numerical paths are unchanged. Initial spring controls use zero refinement pushes and 1800 s, extending the particle08 diagnostic budget to distinguish slow repair from time-limited failure.
The spring-disabled control reaches feasibility at iteration 63 but one anchor leaves its assigned bin (S error 2/540).

The iteration-100 probe finds three ASP fragments; the isolated N is 3.49 A from the one active CYS spring outlier. This suggests a coupled local packing bottleneck and does not rule out spring involvement.
Do not compare smoothed and unsmoothed errors as a matched A/B: their target profiles differ.
Covalent floor enforcement is inter-residue and separate from measured limits; the measured C-O 1.2196 A is retained, but repair must clear the 1.242 A floor.
Reference placement preserves actual radii: 45 distinct values at 1e-6 A form nine shells at 0.01 A gap resolution in the uploaded reference.

Reported RSS is the generation report snapshot before final plot/JSON serialization, not an externally sampled end-to-end peak. Clock-limited or iteration-limited failures are retained, never silently dropped. Scientific expectations are evaluated separately from mandatory geometric validity.

C.interpretation: Exploratory n=3 seed comparison. Seed SD uses ddof=1; no significance claim or universal lower bound.

N.interpretation: Exploratory n=3 seed comparison. Seed SD uses ddof=1; no significance claim or universal lower bound.

O.interpretation: Exploratory n=3 seed comparison. Seed SD uses ddof=1; no significance claim or universal lower bound.

notes: Orientation rotations are about each residue OWN centroid; neither centroid position nor centroid radius is changed.
These are stochastic model error scales, not proven minimum errors or independent experimental validation.
Gap closure is reported raw, including above 1 or negative; gap_closed_clipped additionally caps it at 1.
Undefined floor ratios and nonpositive placement-minus-orientation gaps are null with reasons, never infinite JSON values.
Comparison CSV rows use shape error; raw and shape errors and count ratios remain in JSON.
Chain-label spread is a secondary diagnostic; suggestions are raised only by explicit experimental --compare files.
No second complete experimental CCMV structure was available among the supplied local files; --compare was not invented from a synthetic particle.
All comparisons use the same 50-push v0.1.8 endpoints. Mode effects are described relative to within-mode seed SD and orientation mean; three seeds do not establish statistical significance.
The permutation placement baseline is not the actual initialization algorithm and need not equal iteration-0 error.
Calibration never applies tolerances automatically or relaxes mandatory geometry.
Actual seeded executions on complete protein 1CWP. Time limit 1800 s, max iterations 2000, 50 maximum pushes; no benchmark reached those hard limits.
Normal acceptance stopping retained: full-size valid after 10 pushes; half-bound valid at first feasible geometry with 0 pushes. These are not equal-push comparisons.
Counting multiples use floor means; acceptance uses rounded-up 2 x counting p95, so a mean multiple above 2 can pass.
Half-bound resizing retains 4 A edge ramps and plateau densities, so volume/count scaling is not exactly one eighth.

Fit and initial full-size calibration were first exercised before the development version was bumped; final fit and assessment reports are from 0.1.11. Final assessment tolerances equal the generation inputs.
Prior reference-model particle13 errors C=0.0188,N=0.1081,O=0.0789 are contextual only: they measure a different target, not a head-to-head profile-quality comparison.
Large PDB/JSON/CSV/PNG artifacts and logs are local under .cache/revision06; this file stores compact scalar evidence and replay settings.
Observed wall times include concurrent auxiliary runs/tests; these are packing pilots, not isolated speed benchmarks.
